title: Polygons and multi-product of eigenfunctions
summary: Let $M$ be a compact Riemannian manifold without boundary, with $L^2$-normalized Laplace-Beltrami eigenfunctions $\{e_j\}_j$, which satisfy $Δ_g e_j = -λ_j^2 e_j$. We study the following inner product of eigenfunctions \[ \langle e_{i_1} e_{i_2} \ldots e_{i_k}, e_{i_{k+1}} \rangle = \int e_{i_1} e_{i_2}\ldots e_{i_k} \overline{e_{i_{k+1}}} \, dV. \] We show that, after a mild averaging in the frequency variables, the main $\ell^2$-concentration of this inner product is determined by the measure of a set of configurations of $(k+1)$-gons whose side lengths are the frequencies $λ_{i_1},…
